relationships.subject: photobiomodulation therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: After three weeks of treatment, both PBMT protocols demonstrated a reduction in allodynia and hyperalgesia.

key_findings: PBMT raised pain thresholds in CCI rats and increased spinal TGF-β and GAD65.
PBMT did not inhibit NRSF, HDAC1 or DNMT3a expression.
